entry_id.meaning: The canonical production catalog model_id used by routing and stored-model configuration.
entry_id.authority: dedicated CatalogEntry.entry_id; no alias or profile field may override it
entry_id.stability: unchanged across machine-profile, processing-fingerprint, runtime-config, constrained-runtime, worker-path, and evidence-manifest changes
entry_id.decode_rotation: a changed decode_fingerprint is a new approval identity and never inherits approval

readable_aliases.write_policy: new records write canonical fields; aliases are migration input only

mapping_invariants: CatalogEntry.entry_id is copied byte-for-byte to approval.model_id.
Catalog lookup maps one entry_id to exactly one catalog identity; zero or multiple canonical matches are unmappable_identity.
Two source records that resolve to the same (entry_id, decode_fingerprint) are a duplicate_identity before any approval write.
A profile hash, profile activation epoch, processing fingerprint, runtime config digest, constrained identity, worker identity, or manifest revision cannot change model_id.
The all-empty m5-validation-machine source record is not a catalog mapping and is excluded from the migration seed.
Canonical field validation and alias agreement happen before decode-fingerprint calculation and before migration writes.
validation_order: resolve source_catalog_entry_id to exactly one production CatalogEntry
